description: A team lead must redesign a weekly cross-functional retrospective after participants report that its discussion format is discouraging candid participation. The lead must set the participation format, notice period, facilitation arrangement, incident record, and initial support commitments.

shared_context.S1: The cross-functional retrospective currently meets for 60 minutes every Thursday afternoon.
shared_context.S2: Several participants have said that interruptions and improvised exercises make it harder to discuss problems candidly.
shared_context.S3: The current retrospective facilitator is leaving the team at the end of the month.
shared_context.S4: Before finalizing a revised process, Maya follows the team's normal practice of asking each affected participant what would make the meeting workable and who should help run it.

PF1.text: Renee needs questions and discussion prompts in writing at least 48 hours before the retrospective and cannot take part in unmoderated live role-play; she has not raised this in the group because prior prompts have usually arrived informally on the day of the meeting.

PF2.text: Jon personally observed exactly four occasions this quarter when one participant interrupted another during the retrospective, and he previously agreed to serve as the neutral timekeeper for the first six revised sessions; he has not put either point into the team's process notes.

acceptance_conditions: The revised retrospective must use written prompts with optional moderated live follow-up.
Prompts and discussion questions must be distributed exactly 48 hours before each session.
The process must document exactly four interruption incidents.
The first six revised sessions must use a neutral-timekeeper facilitation arrangement.
A commitment must assign Jon as neutral timekeeper for the first six revised sessions.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'neutral_timekeeper' and c['target'] == 'Jon' and c['detail'] == 'first six revised sessions' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Renee's specific participation boundary changes the format to written prompts with moderated follow-up and fixes the notice period at exactly 48 hours.
Jon's firsthand record changes the documented incident count to exactly four and his prior agreement changes the facilitation plan and commitment to a neutral timekeeper for exactly six sessions.
